headline: Taiwan Regulator Blocks Proposed Merger Between Grab and Foodpanda
summary: Taiwan's Fair Trade Commission blocked the proposed merger between Grab and Foodpanda, citing concerns over reduced market competition stemming from Uber's stake in Grab.
why: Anti-monopoly regulators frequently review cross-border technology acquisitions to prevent market dominance and protect consumer pricing.

impacts.name: Uber Technologies Inc
impacts.why: Regulatory blocking of regional partnerships affects strategic delivery market expansions.
